$comment: Machine-readable event contract for Cosmic Shore. Source of truth for configuring the UGS dashboard Event Manager (every event AND parameter must be declared there or the backend silently discards the event) and for PostHog insight definitions. Keep in sync with UGSKeys.cs and AnalyticsServiceFacade.cs; bump schema_version when a field's meaning changes. Descriptions are mandatory in the UGS Add Custom Event / Add Custom Parameter dialogs, so every event and parameter carries one here.

common_envelope.$comment: Froglet Analytics ONLY (PostHog before 2026-11-06) - stamped by FrogletAnalyticsSink, not by the facade. UGS Analytics auto-collects the player id, platform and app version as core data, and it validates every custom parameter against a schema hand-created in the dashboard Event Manager, where events and parameters can never be deleted and count against a 1,500-per-environment cap. Sending these to UGS would cost 168 permanent schema rows for data it already has. game_completed carries its own client-stamped timestamp as a real event parameter, and that one DOES go to both sinks.

player_id.description: UGS authentication PlayerId. Canonical identity and the PostHog distinct_id.

timestamp_utc_ms.description: Client clock at emit, Unix epoch milliseconds UTC.

timestamp_utc_iso.description: Same instant, ISO-8601, for day/week/month bucketing without conversion.

person_properties.$comment: PostHog only. Set via $identify on collection start, on cloud-profile change, and at session end (pause/quit). Mirrors PLAYER_PROFILE / HANGAR_DATA / GAME_MODE_PROGRESSION.

display_name.description: Player-chosen free text. Searchable, never the identity key. Its presence is what makes the privacy-policy disclosure a release blocker.

first_seen_utc_ms.description: UTC ms of the player's first session. Stamped once, never rewritten, cloud-backed so it follows the account rather than the device. NOTE: identity is UGS anonymous auth today, so a reinstall that loses the session token creates a NEW person with a NEW first-seen - see DATA_ARCHITECTURE.md 7.3.3. Written ONLY when known - an identify that lands before the cloud profile loads omits it rather than $set-ting 0 over the real value.

invite_wave.description: Invite-wave cohort: the yyyy-MM-dd key of the UTC week (its Monday) that first_seen_utc_ms falls in. The dimension the paid-EA gate splits retention (D1/D7) and crash-free sessions by. A PROXY for a Steam grant batch, not the batch itself - Steam hands the client no wave number, so a tester who requested access in week 1 and installed in week 3 is in wave 3. Empty when first-seen is unknown; empty is not a cohort. Person property only - never an event parameter, so it costs zero UGS schema rows. See DATA_ARCHITECTURE.md 7.3.3.

preferred_vessel.description: Most-flown vessel, derived from HANGAR_DATA flight time.

gdpr_deletion_requested.description: Set by the in-game erasure button. The client cannot delete a PostHog person with a write-only key, so an operator or server-side automation must complete the deletion. See DATA_ARCHITECTURE.md 8.6.

game_started.description: A game begins: fires once when the countdown ends and players are given control. Menu freestyle never raises it.

match_id.description: Unique id for one game instance. Groups every player who was in the same match.

party_id.description: Relay party session id. Stable across consecutive matches by the same party, so a rematch is a different match_id but the same party_id.

player_ids.encoding: comma-joined for UGS, real array in PostHog
player_ids.description: Comma-joined, sorted UGS player ids of the humans in the match. AI is excluded.

invite_triggered.description: True when the party formed through a formal invite, false when players met through the presence lobby. Separates organic rematches from re-invited ones.

player_count_human.description: Number of human players in the match.

player_count_ai.description: Number of AI players backfilled into the match.

game_mode.description: The game mode, as its GameModes enum name.

intensity.description: Selected intensity tier for the game mode.

vessel_class.description: The vessel the local player flew, as its VesselClassType enum name.

player_count.description: Total configured player count for the session, humans plus AI.

ai_count.description: Requested AI backfill count for the session.

is_multiplayer.description: True when the session ran as a multiplayer game mode.

element.description: The match's element: the mode's genre petal from ModeGenre.TryElementsFor (Charge, Mass, Space, Time; Omni). Absent when the mode has no genre. Froglet Analytics only (2026-11-06): the UGS sink strips it, so UGS needs no Event Manager row.

element_secondary.description: The mode's second genre element when it has two (Brood Rush: Mass and Space); absent otherwise. Froglet Analytics only (2026-11-06): the UGS sink strips it, so UGS needs no Event Manager row.

domain.description: The local player's domain (Jade, Ruby, Gold, ...). Froglet Analytics only (2026-11-07): the UGS sink strips it. From the LOCAL player's side; absent when there is no local player.

humans_on_my_domain.description: Humans on the local player's domain, the local player included. Froglet Analytics only (2026-11-07): the UGS sink strips it. From the LOCAL player's side; absent when there is no local player.

humans_on_other_domains.description: Humans on every other domain. 0 = every human is on one team. Froglet Analytics only (2026-11-07): the UGS sink strips it. From the LOCAL player's side; absent when there is no local player.

ai_on_my_domain.description: AI pilots on the local player's domain (AI teammates). Froglet Analytics only (2026-11-07): the UGS sink strips it. From the LOCAL player's side; absent when there is no local player.

ai_on_other_domains.description: AI pilots on every other domain (AI opponents). Froglet Analytics only (2026-11-07): the UGS sink strips it. From the LOCAL player's side; absent when there is no local player.

game_completed.description: A game ends. Carries flight time, wall-clock duration and the match grouping keys.

flight_time_seconds.description: Seconds the player actually spent at the controls: countdown end to game end, excluding pause and time in the background.

duration_seconds.description: Wall-clock seconds from game start to game end, pause included. The gap against flight_time_seconds is pause plus idle time.

match_id.description: Unique id for one game instance. Groups every player who was in the same match.

party_id.description: Relay party session id. Stable across consecutive matches by the same party, so a rematch is a different match_id but the same party_id.

player_won.description: True when the local player was on the winning side.

game_mode.description: The game mode, as its GameModes enum name.

intensity.description: Selected intensity tier for the game mode.

vessel_class.description: The vessel the local player flew, as its VesselClassType enum name.

player_count.description: Total configured player count for the session, humans plus AI.

ai_count.description: Requested AI backfill count for the session.

is_multiplayer.description: True when the session ran as a multiplayer game mode.

timestamp_utc_ms.description: Client clock at game completion, Unix epoch milliseconds UTC.

timestamp_utc_iso.description: Client clock at game completion, ISO-8601 UTC, for day, week and month bucketing.

element.description: The match's element: the mode's genre petal from ModeGenre.TryElementsFor (Charge, Mass, Space, Time; Omni). Absent when the mode has no genre. Froglet Analytics only (2026-11-06): the UGS sink strips it, so UGS needs no Event Manager row.

element_secondary.description: The mode's second genre element when it has two (Brood Rush: Mass and Space); absent otherwise. Froglet Analytics only (2026-11-06): the UGS sink strips it, so UGS needs no Event Manager row.

score.description: The local player's own final score, as the mode scores it (GameDataSO.Results, else the round stats). Golf modes (finish times) are lower-is-better. Absent when the local player is not among the results. Froglet Analytics only (2026-11-07): the UGS sink strips it, so UGS needs no Event Manager row.

placement.description: The local player's rank among every pilot in the match, AI included: 1 = best, the scoreboard's order. In a team mode it is the player's own row, not the team's. Absent when the local player is not among the results. Froglet Analytics only (2026-11-07): the UGS sink strips it, so UGS needs no Event Manager row.

players_in_match.description: Pilots ranked in the match, humans and AI. Absent when the mode produced no results. Froglet Analytics only (2026-11-07): the UGS sink strips it, so UGS needs no Event Manager row.

ai_difficulty.description: The level the AI opponents (AI on another domain than the local player's) flew, as the AIDifficulty enum names it: Easy, Medium, Hard, Legendary, or Mixed when per-seat picks differed. Sent only by the machine that seated the bots (the host, or a solo game); absent on a guest and when no AI opposed the player. Froglet Analytics only (2026-11-07): the UGS sink strips it, so UGS needs no Event Manager row.

behind_by.description: Distance between the best score in the match and the local player's own; 0 when the player's side won (player_won). In a team mode the best score is the best individual row. Froglet Analytics only (2026-11-07): the UGS sink strips it, so UGS needs no Event Manager row.

reason.description: Why the session ended: pause or quit.

last_ui_action.description: Label of the last UI action before the session ended. Churn forensics.

app_state.description: Application state machine phase at the moment the session ended.

session_id.description: The session this end belongs to: session_started's session_id. Froglet Analytics only (2026-11-07): the UGS sink strips it, so UGS needs no Event Manager row.

session_seconds.description: Seconds in the foreground in this session so far (time in the background is not counted). A session that pauses and resumes within 30 minutes sends one session_ended per pause, each with its running total. Froglet Analytics only (2026-11-07): the UGS sink strips it, so UGS needs no Event Manager row.

session_ended.description: The app was paused or quit. One per session.

play_again_pressed.description: The player pressed Play Again on the end-of-game scoreboard.

action_type.description: Category of the UI action that was performed.

action_label.description: Human-readable label of the UI element the player acted on.

action_value.description: Optional value carried by the UI action.

ui_action.description: A tracked UI interaction, such as menu navigation or a button press.

ad_impression.description: An ad finished loading and was shown to the player.

game_first_launched.description: First ever launch on this device. Fires once, guarded by a device-local flag.

is_first.description: True when this was the first occurrence in the current session.

seconds_since_launch.description: Seconds elapsed since the app launched. Time-to-first-action analysis.

menu_ready.description: The main menu became fully interactive and the player can act.

seconds_since_launch.description: Seconds elapsed since the app launched. Time-to-first-action analysis.

vessel_class.description: The vessel the player took control of in Freestyle (the Toybox). Froglet Analytics only (2026-11-06): the UGS sink strips it, so UGS needs no Event Manager row.

freestyle_entered.description: The player took manual control of the menu vessel, entering freestyle flight.

game_mode.description: The game mode, as its GameModes enum name.

mode_unlocked.description: A game mode became available to the player through progression.

crystal_spend_blocked.description: A purchase was attempted with an insufficient balance. The economy starvation signal.

balance.description: The player's crystal balance after this event.

vessel_unlocked.description: A vessel was unlocked, whether purchased with crystals or granted.

crystal_balance_snapshot.description: The player's crystal balance at session end, for hoarding versus spending analysis.

target_id.description: UGS player id of the person the request or invite was sent to.

friend_request_sent.description: The player sent a friend request to another player.

from_id.description: UGS player id of the person the friend request came from.

friend_request_received.description: The player received a friend request from another player.

friend_id.description: UGS player id of the player who became a friend.

friend_added.description: A friendship was established after a request was accepted.

target_id.description: UGS player id of the person the request or invite was sent to.

invite_id.description: Invite id: 16 hex digits hashed from sender id, invited player id and the sender's party session id (InviteAttribution). The invitee computes the same id from the invite it receives, so the two events join without a new field on the invite itself. The same invite repeated into the same party session gets the same id. Froglet Analytics only (2026-11-07): the UGS sink strips it, so UGS needs no Event Manager row.

party_invite_sent.description: The player invited another player to their party.

host_id.description: UGS player id of the party host who sent the invite.

invite_id.description: Invite id, computed by the invitee from the invite (sender, itself, party session): equal to the sender's party_invite_sent invite_id. Froglet Analytics only (2026-11-07): the UGS sink strips it, so UGS needs no Event Manager row.

party_invite_received.description: The player received a party invite.

invite_id.description: The invite that led to this join: the remembered party_invite_received whose party session is the one joined. Absent for a join no invite led to (a presence join, a rejoin). Froglet Analytics only (2026-11-07): the UGS sink strips it, so UGS needs no Event Manager row.

inviter_id.description: UGS player id of the player who sent that invite. Absent when invite_id is. Froglet Analytics only (2026-11-07): the UGS sink strips it, so UGS needs no Event Manager row.

party_joined.description: The player successfully joined another player's party.

game_mode.description: The game mode, as its GameModes enum name.

favorited.description: True when the minigame was favorited, false when it was unfavorited.

minigame_favorited.description: The player favorited or unfavorited a minigame.

game_mode.description: The game mode, as its GameModes enum name.

share_triggered.description: The player used the native share sheet to share something from the game.

quest.description: Title of the quest that was completed.

shard_value.description: Reward value granted for completing the quest.

quest_completed.description: The player completed a quest and claimed its reward.

game_mode.description: The game mode, as its GameModes enum name.

fail_count.description: How many games have now been lost consecutively.

repeated_game_fail.description: The player lost several games in a row. A frustration and churn-risk signal.

key.description: The Cloud Save key whose write failed.

cloud_save_failed.description: A Cloud Save write exhausted all retries while online. Backend health signal.

ftue_step_completed.description: One node of the FTUE quest graph completed (the activation funnel's steps). Sent by AnalyticsServiceFacade.HandleFtueStepCompleted.

quest_id.description: The quest graph's id (Assets/FTUE); "unknown" when the quest has none.

phase_index.description: Zero-based index of the quest phase.

step_id.description: The node's stable id, so re-wording a node never forks the funnel.

step_name.description: The node's display name; its id when it has none.

seconds_since_launch.description: Seconds since the app launched, at the moment the event fired.

ftue_phase_completed.description: A phase of the FTUE quest graph completed.

quest_id.description: The quest graph's id (Assets/FTUE); "unknown" when the quest has none.

phase_index.description: Zero-based index of the quest phase.

seconds_since_launch.description: Seconds since the app launched, at the moment the event fired.

ftue_completed.description: The whole FTUE quest graph completed.

quest_id.description: The quest graph's id (Assets/FTUE); "unknown" when the quest has none.

seconds_since_launch.description: Seconds since the app launched, at the moment the event fired.

freestyle_ended.description: A Freestyle (Toybox) stretch ended: the player left freestyle flight (a game, a menu, pause or quit). One per stretch, with its length from FlightClock. Froglet Analytics only (2026-11-06): the UGS sink strips it, so UGS needs no Event Manager row.

seconds.description: Seconds of freestyle flight in this stretch (FlightClock.OnFreestyleSegmentCompleted).

vessel_class.description: The vessel flown at the end of the stretch.

vessels_flown.description: Distinct vessels flown during the stretch (1 when they never switched).

seconds_since_launch.description: Seconds elapsed since the app launched.

freestyle_vessel_changed.description: The player switched vessels in Freestyle (the Toybox's Vessel Changer). Froglet Analytics only (2026-11-06): the UGS sink strips it, so UGS needs no Event Manager row.

seconds_in_freestyle.description: Seconds into the current freestyle stretch.

session_started.description: A session began: a cold start of the app, or a return from the background after more than 30 minutes away (AnalyticsSessionClock). Sent once collection runs, so a session whose consent comes later starts late. Froglet Analytics only (2026-11-07): the UGS sink drops it, so UGS needs no Event Manager row.

session_id.description: A fresh GUID per session; session_ended carries the same one.

launch_kind.description: cold (the app started) or resume (back from more than 30 minutes in the background).

match_abandoned.description: The player left a running match before its end: once per match at most, never together with game_completed for the same match. Froglet Analytics only (2026-11-07): the UGS sink drops it, so UGS needs no Event Manager row.

match_id.description: As on game_started for this match.

party_id.description: As on game_started for this match.

invite_triggered.description: As on game_started for this match.

player_count_ai.description: As on game_started for this match.

element_secondary.description: As on game_started for this match.

humans_on_my_domain.description: As on game_started for this match.

humans_on_other_domains.description: As on game_started for this match.

ai_on_other_domains.description: As on game_started for this match.

ai_difficulty.description: As on game_completed: the opponent AI's level, sent only by the machine that seated the bots.

elapsed_seconds.description: Wall-clock seconds from game_started to the quit, pause included.

flight_time_seconds.description: Seconds at the controls in this match until the quit (FlightClock, pause and background excluded). Absent when the flight clock had already been reset.

reason.description: quit_to_menu (any scene change out of the running match: the pause menu's Main Menu, and for a guest also the host taking the party out), app_quit (the app closed during the match), or disconnect (the guest's link to the host broke, or the network went away during the match).

score_at_quit.description: The local player's round score at the quit (RoundStats.Score). Many modes assign the score only at the end, so 0 here can mean not scored yet.

placement_at_quit.description: The local player's rank by score at the quit (1 = best, ties share a rank). Sent only for a higher-is-better scoring rule with some score on the board; absent for golf modes (finish times) and before anyone scored.

client_exception.description: An exception or logged error on the client (Application.logMessageReceivedThreaded, LogType Exception and Error). No message text is ever sent: only a hash of it. One event per distinct message_hash per session (repeats within a 5 s fold window are counted), at most 20 per session; behind the consent gate like every event. Froglet Analytics only (2026-11-07): the UGS sink drops it, so UGS needs no Event Manager row.

exception_type.description: The exception's type name (NullReferenceException), or LogError for a Debug.LogError line.

top_frame.description: The first project frame of the stack trace as Namespace.Class.Method (the CSDebug logging helper skipped); the first frame of any kind when no project frame is on it; unknown when there is no trace.

scene.description: The active scene when it was logged.

message_hash.description: 12 hex digits: FNV-1a 64 of the message's first line with every digit removed, so the same fault with different numbers is one row.

count.description: Occurrences folded into this event: the first sighting plus the repeats seen before it was sent.

organic_rematch.description: Two sessions by the same human subset, same mode, neither prompted by an invite, within X days - and in DIFFERENT sittings.
organic_rematch.note: The different-party_id clause is what stops three back-to-back games in one evening from registering as rematches. Rematch rate by game_mode = organic rematches / distinct player subsets that played that mode.
